# Physical components in the code
This section sums up the primary physical processes and roughly indicates where they can be found in the code.

## Irrigation
In `demand/water_demand.jl`
This provides types `AllocationLandModel`,`AllocationRiverModel`, `PaddyModel` and `DemandModel` and related functionality.
## Glaciers
In `glacier`
The HBV behaviour of the glacier storage is found in `glacier_process.jl`,
while `glacier.jl` wraps this functionality in a `GlacierHBVmodel` type.
## Routing
### Surface water
In `routing/surface`
This involves routing of
* rivers
* floodplains
* reservoirs
* lateral snow transport
For rivers and floodplains a kinematic wave or local inertial is used, for reservoirs a variety of reservoir models is available (inflow, outflow versus stage). Lateral snow transport is dependent on terrain slope and local snow accumulation.

### Subsurface water
In `routing/subsurface`
This contains the time-forward groundwater model (explicit evaluation of groundwater levels in time)
The wflow model type determines the type of subsurface model:
* sbm models use the  `LateralSSFModel` (kinematic wave approach)
* sbm_gwf models use the `GroundwaterFlowModel` (time-explicit Darcy)

## Sediment
### Erosion
In `sediment/erosion`<br>
Local erosion of the soil.

### Sediment transport
In `sediment/transport` <br>
Transport, exchange of sediment from one domain to another (i.e. land to river) ánd deposition (the inverse of erosion).

## Snow
In `snow`<br>
This implements the `SnowHbvModel`.
The physics of the HBV snow model is found in `snow_process.jl`


## Soil (top)
In `soil`<br>
Describes the top processes like infiltration, which also encompasses the
unsaturated zone (Brooks-Corey approach).

## Runoff
In `surfacewater`<br>
Delivers the river runoff given the net runoff from surface to river, taking into account the open water evaoration at land and river.

## Vegetation
In `vegetation`<br>
Canopy processes in `canopy.jl`:
The interception of rainfall, evaporation from interception and transpiration implemented in `rainfall_interception.jl` and wrapped for models in `canopy.jl`

# Model components in the code
## BMI adapter

See `Wflow/src/bmi.jl` for the implementation. Key responsibilities:

- Initialization and lifecycle
- Time-stepping helpers
- Variable and grid interface
- State I/O helpers
- Utility helpers

A more elaborate description can be found under the section Basic Modelling Interface

## Core model composition

The model instance `Model` composite type (`Wflow/src/Wflow.jl`) aggregates the following elements:

- `Config` *complete configuration of the model*
- `Domain` *topology of the domain*
- `Routing` *routing model; latereal fluxes*
- `Land` *land model; vertical processes*
- `MassBalance` *book keeping of water volumes and fluxes*
- `Clock` *keeping track of simulation time; time stepping*
- `Reader` *input forcing data*
- `Writer` *output result data*

Three types of models are based on this template:
* `sbm` in structure `SbmModel` in `sbm_model.jl`
* `sbm_gwf` in structure `SbmGwfModel` in `sbm_gwf_model.jl`
* `sediment` in structure `SedimentModel` in `sediment_model.jl`

The `sbm` and `sbm_gwf` differ only in their approach of the subsurface transport treatment, `sbm_gwf` has a full time-dependent Darcy model, `sbm` uses the kinematic-wave approach, based on elevation. The `sediment`model has no subsurface component and does not keep track of mass balances, but in addition implements overland sediment transport.
`
## Domain, network and indices

- `Wflow/src/domain.jl`
  - Defines `Domain` and helpers such as `active_indices(domain, key)` and index maps between 1D internal arrays and 2D spatial coordinates.
  - BMI relies on `active_indices(...)` to compute node counts and to slice internal arrays for BMI exchange. See `bmi.jl`.

- `Wflow/src/network.jl` and routing submodules
  - Graph-based connectivity, adjacent-node tables, and edge indices used by BMI `get_grid_edge_nodes` and routing code.


## Routing and land models

- Routing core: `Wflow/src/routing/routing.jl` and many `routing/*` submodules
  - Implements `Routing` abstract and concrete routing models (river, overland, subsurface). Routing exposes property lenses used by BMI `grid_element_type` logic.

- Land and hydrology: `Wflow/src/sbm.jl`, `Wflow/src/sbm_model.jl`
  - Soil/land vertical processes and `LandHydrologySBM` implementations; standard-name mappings for soil-layer variables that BMI recognizes.


## Standard-name metadata and variable lenses

- Standard-name modules under `Wflow/src/standard_name/`
  - Provide mappings from human/standard names to `PropertyLens` accessors into `Model` fields.
  - BMI uses `get_metadata(name; model)` and lenses to obtain references to internal arrays for `get_value_ptr` and `set_value`.


## State, mass-balance, and output

- `Wflow/src/states.jl` — state extraction/restoration and `set_states!`/`extract_required_states` helpers used by `load_state`/`save_state`.
- `Wflow/src/mass_balance.jl` — mass balance bookkeeping used during `run_timestep!`.
- `Wflow/src/io.jl` — output NetCDF writing helpers.

# Source file overview
The following gives a categorisation of the files in the Wflow code base.
The hierarchy follows the actual directory structure of the code.

- **demand**
	- `water_demand.jl` *crop irrigation model; calculates the water demand for irrigation*
- **glacier**
	- `glacier_process.jl` *HBV-light glacier modelling*
	- `glacier.jl` *wraps glacier_process (plus data structure) into a glacier model*
- **routing**
	- **subsurface** *groundwater flow*
		- `boundary_conditions.jl`  (*well, river, drain, constant head, recharge ...*)
		- `connectivity.jl` *two-dimensional structured (row,col) connectivity matrix*
		- `groundwater.jl` *Time-explicit (instationary) Darcy equation in two dimensions*
		- `lateral_subsurface_flow.jl` *Misc. data structures for lateral subsurface flow and forcing*
		- `subsurface_process.jl` *kinematic wave model model for lateral subsurface flow including lateral snow transport*
	- **surface**
		- `floodplain.jl` *Floodplain flow model for river sections*
		- `reservoir.jl` *Reservoir model and data structures (storage and outflow etc.)*
		- `surface_flow.jl` *high-level data structures for river and overland flow model)*
		- `surface_kinwave.jl` *Kinematic wave model for rivers, floodplains and reservoirs, initialization and time stepping*
		- `surface_process.jl`
		- `surface_routing.jl`
		- `surface_staggered_scheme.jl` *Support for staggered spatial discretisation of rivers (flows on edges)*
	- `initialize_routing.jl` *initialize a routing model for lateral subsurface flow*
	- `routing.jl` *generic struct for routing model components, overland, river and subsurface*
  - `timestepping.jl` *struct and initialization of timestepping for the kinematic wave equation*
  - `utils.jl` *utility converting gridded drainage direction to a graph*
- **sediment**
	- **erosion**
      - `erosion_process.jl`  *implementation rainfall and overland flow erosion models and combined effect*
      - `overland_flow_erosion.jl` *wraps overland flow erosion models in erosion_process*
      - `rainfall_erosion.jl` *wraps rainfall erosion models in erosion_process*
      - `soil_erosion.jl` *wraps soil erosion models (combined flow and rainfall) in erosion_process*
	- **sediment_transport**
      - `deposition.jl` *deposition of sediment in reservoirs*
      - `land_to_river.jl` *sediment flux from land to river*
      - `river_transport.jl` *river sediment transport model*
      - `overland_flow_transport.jl` *overland sediment transport model*
      - `transport_capacity.jl` *sediment transport capacity model*
      - `transport_capacity_process.jl` *wraps transport_capacity (plus data structure)*
- **snow**
	- `snow_process.jl` *HBV implementation of snow processes (melt and precipitation etc.)*
	- `snow.jl` *wraps snow_process (plus data structure) into a snow_model*
- **soil**
	- `soil_process.jl` *infiltration model*
	- `soil.jl` *wraps soil_process (plus data structure) intol a soil model*
- **standard_name**   *records of parameter metadata for variables, indexed by CDMS standard names*
	- `standard_name_domain.jl`
	- `standard_name_routing.jl`
	- `standard_name_sbm.jl`
	- `standard_name_sediment.jl`
	- `standard_name_utils.jl` *utilities to retrieve metadata fields by CDMS standard name*
- **surfacewater**
	- `runoff.jl` *open water runoff model, water flux from atmospheric forcing*
- **vegetation** *canopy rainfall interception model*
	- `parameters.jl` *analyze vegetation parameters*
	- `rainfall_interception.jl` *different interception models from literature (Gash, modified Rutter)*
	- `canopy.jl` *wraps rainfall interception models (plus data structure)*
- `bmi.jl` *basic model interface (API) for the library*
- `config_init.jl` *initialize config section with dict and NetCDF input*
- `config_structure.jl` *input and output of config data*
- `config_utils.jl`
- `domain.jl` *defines and initializes different domains (Land, River, Reservoir)*
- `erosion.jl` *SoilLossModel composed from the different erosion types and atmospheric and hydrologic forcings*
- `forcing.jl` *data structures for atmospheric and hydrologic forcing*
- `io.jl` *NetCDF I/O functionality (forcing, writing results)*
- `logging.jl` *everything related to log messages I/O*
- `mass_balance.jl` *storages and net fluxes for establishing the water balance*
- `network.jl` *definition of the Land-, River and Drain Network type plus utility functions*
- `sbm_gwf_model.jl` *constructor and update function of subsurface sbm_gwf model instance*
- `sbm_model.jl`  *constructor and update functions of sbm model instance*
- `sediment_flux.jl` *sediment transport model (river and overland flow) using implementations in **sediment_transport***
- `sediment_model.jl` *complete sediment model, erosion and sediment transport*
- `states.jl` *retrieval of the state of various model components*
- `subdomains.jl` *topology (graph) and ordering of subbasins, preparation of kinematic wave*
- `units.jl` *administration of variable units and conversions expressed in powers of elementary SI units and conversion factors*
- `utils.jl` *miscellaneous utility functions*
- `Wflow.jl` *comprehensive Wflow module encompassing all above elements and generic Model factory returning one of SbmModel, SbmGwfModel or SedimentModel*
